sys.path.insert(0, "/root/cases/case_138")
import kernel as K

# all FP16 subnormal bit patterns + signed zeros + crossover region values
vals = []
for b in range(1, 1024):  # subnormal magnitudes
    v = torch.tensor(b, dtype=torch.uint16).view(torch.float16).item()
    vals += [v, -v]
vals += [0.0, -0.0]
for b in [1024, 1536, 1792, 2048, 2560, 3072, 4096, 5120, 6144, 7168]:  # values ~6e-5..1.4e-4 region
    v = torch.tensor(b, dtype=torch.uint16).view(torch.float16).item()
    vals += [v, -v]
xs = torch.tensor(vals, dtype=torch.float16, device="cuda")
out = K.run(xs)
r64 = xs.to(torch.float64); sq = r64*r64; rho = torch.sqrt(1.0+sq)-1.0
err = (out.to(torch.float64)-rho).abs()
tol = 1e-8 + 1e-5*rho.abs()
viol = err > tol
idx = viol.nonzero().flatten().tolist()
print(json.dumps({"n": xs.numel(), "num_violations": int(viol.sum()), "violation_indices_first10": idx[:10],
  "max_err": err.max().item(), "max_ratio_err_over_tol": (err/tol).max().item(),
  "zero_out_plus": out[vals.index(0.0)].item(), "zero_out_minus": out[vals.index(-0.0)].item()}))
", "expected_signal": "count of mixed-tolerance violations over all subnormal/near-zero FP16 values (0 = rebutted, >0 = confirmed)"}

sys.path.insert(0, "/root/cases/case_138")
import kernel as K

# contiguous view with nonzero storage offset, N=4093 (not multiple of 256)
N, KOFF = 4093, 7
base = (2.0*torch.randn(5000, generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(1))).to(torch.float16).cuda()
x = base[KOFF:KOFF+N]
assert x.is_contiguous() and x.storage_offset() == KOFF
before = x.clone()
out = K.run(x)
r64 = x.to(torch.float64); sq = r64*r64; rho = torch.sqrt(1.0+sq)-1.0
err = (out.to(torch.float64)-rho).abs(); tol = 1e-8 + 1e-5*rho.abs()
input_preserved = bool(torch.equal(before, x))
# also test N=1 and N=131072 with offset
base2 = (2.0*torch.randn(140000, generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(2))).to(torch.float16).cuda()
x2 = base2[3:3+131072]
out2 = K.run(x2)
rho2 = torch.sqrt(1.0 + x2.to(torch.float64)**2) - 1.0
err2 = (out2.to(torch.float64)-rho2).abs(); tol2 = 1e-8 + 1e-5*rho2.abs()
x1 = base2[5:6]
out1 = K.run(x1)
rho1 = torch.sqrt(1.0 + x1.to(torch.float64)**2) - 1.0
err1 = (out1.to(torch.float64)-rho1).abs(); tol1 = 1e-8 + 1e-5*rho1.abs()
print(json.dumps({"offset": KOFF, "n": N, "violations_n4093": int((err>tol).sum()), "input_preserved": input_preserved,
  "n_max": 131072, "violations_n131072": int((err2>tol2).sum()), "n1": 1, "violations_n1": int((err1>tol1).sum()),
  "tail_last5_err": err[-5:].tolist(), "head_first5_err": err[:5].tolist()}))
", "expected_signal": "tolerance violations for offset view at odd N plus N=1 and N=131072 (0 = rebutted, >0 = confirmed)"}
